title: 第011章 姐，他好像很喜欢我
slug: 醉酒亲错人年下弟弟失控发疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

临近十一点，舒楹手机响起了陌生号码。

来电显示是在本地，号码数字很好，乍一看有些熟悉。

她犹豫两秒，电话就挂断了，仿佛只是打错了一样。

会是谢亭渝吗？

舒楹大脑发散了一下，事后立马自我否定。

这时，许栀意的消息发了过来。

是栀栀呀：【总算脱离危险了/小猫开心】

是栀栀呀：【王特助送我回家啦，姐姐你别担心我】

sy：【好】

她放下手机，自嘲地笑笑。

为什么总是不长记性？人家早就有了心爱的另一半，她一个三年前始乱终弃的前任瞎凑什么热闹？

许栀意那张温柔小意的脸在她脑海闪过。

她该祝福他们的……

“……麻麻？麻麻不哭。”绵绵睁开眼睛，仰头看向舒楹。

她这一周受到药物的影响总是昏昏欲睡，白嫩的小脸因为激素反应变得圆鼓鼓的，唯独那双和谢亭渝如出一辙的大眼睛在清醒时依旧亮闪闪的。

“绵绵醒了呀，今天难不难受？”

舒楹吸了口气，低头亲吻绵绵的额头，“妈妈没哭，是太困了。”

绵绵仰着头“噢”了一声，伸手打了个哈欠，“姨姨饭饭很好吃。”

“思嘉阿姨做的减脂餐吗？”

“嗯！”绵绵舔了舔嘴唇，有些馋了，“姨姨，给我做饭饭。”

王思嘉在护理方面很专业。前些天医生来查房，她拿着小本本做了好多笔记，几乎跟舒楹的不相上下。

激素会让绵绵胃口大开，但药物要求低脂饮食和黏膜护理。王思嘉不仅做了很多漂亮的小食，每天都会定时给绵绵用漱口水预防口腔溃疡。

零零碎碎的事情很多，要不是囊中羞涩，舒楹都忍不住想给她加工资。

“那绵绵早点睡觉，明天醒来就可以吃到啦。”舒楹笑着拍了拍绵绵的肩膀。

“吼！”绵绵开心地露出了小乳牙。

舒楹端详着她天真纯粹的模样，再怎么辛苦都是值得的。

Near eleven o'clock, Shu Ying's cell phone rang with an unknown number.

The caller ID is local, the number is well digitized and looks familiar at first glance.

She hesitated for two seconds and then hung up the phone, as if she had made a wrong call.

Could it be Xie Tingyu?

Shu Ying's mind wandered for a moment, and he immediately denied himself afterward.

At this time, Xu Zhiyi's message came over.

It’s Zhizhi: [Finally out of danger/The kitten is happy]

It’s Zhizhi: [Special Assistant Wang sent me home, sister, don’t worry about me]

sy: [OK]

She put down her phone and smiled to herself.

Why don't you always have a long memory?She already has a beloved partner, so why is her ex, who started a relationship and finally abandoned her three years ago, joining in the fun?

Xu Zhiyi's gentle and carefree face flashed in her mind.

She should bless them...

"...Mom? Mom, don't cry." Mianmian opened her eyes and looked up at Shu Ying.

She has been drowsy under the influence of medicine this week, and her fair face has become swollen due to the hormone reaction, but her big eyes, which are exactly the same as Xie Tingyu's, are still shining when she is awake.

"Mianmian is awake. Are you feeling uncomfortable today?"

Shu Ying took a breath, lowered her head and kissed Mian Mian's forehead, "Mom didn't cry, she was too sleepy."

Mianmian raised her head and said "Oh", stretched out her hand and yawned, "Auntie's food is delicious."

"Aunt Scarlett's fat-reducing meal?"

"Well!" Mianmian licked her lips, a little greedy, "Auntie, cook for me."

Wang Sijia is very professional in nursing.When the doctor came for rounds a few days ago, she took a lot of notes in a small notebook, which was almost as good as Shu Ying's.

Hormones can increase Mianmian's appetite, but medications require a low-fat diet and mucosal care.Wang Sijia not only made a lot of beautiful snacks, but also used mouthwash for Mianmian regularly every day to prevent oral ulcers.

There were so many odds and ends that Shu Ying couldn't help but want to give her a salary increase if it weren't for the fact that she was short of money.

"Then Mianmian, go to bed early and you can eat it when you wake up tomorrow." Shu Ying smiled and patted Mianmian on the shoulder.

"Roar!" Mianmian happily showed her baby teeth.

Shu Ying looked at her innocent and pure appearance, no matter how hard she worked, it was all worth it.
